citations.name: habeas:coverage
citations.commentary:
This edge-only validation regression deliberately supplies no node
 contents. Its records assert selection dependencies only. Contents
 requires this callback, but reaching it would introduce an unwanted
 content read and fail this guard.

rationale:
The `habeas:coverage` citation sits on an explicit function with a body, `node_content` in `impl[GraphWithChangingEdges/Contents]`. It is a fenced comment that is part of the assessed item. That is a permitted form for this built-in.

The explanation is substantive and matches the source:
- `Contents` requires `node_content`, so the test graph must define it.
- The test `agent_edge_tools_record_selections_without_validating_targets` is edge-only. The scripted agent calls only `outgoing_edges` and then `submit_result`.
- The test asserts that the stored dependencies are exactly one `Dependency::OutgoingEdges`.
- A content read would add an unwanted dependency. The body of `node_content` panics so that any such read fails the guard.
- Zero execution of this callback is therefore the intended outcome.

Nothing in the test contradicts the explanation or depends on the callback running. The reason is more than difficulty. Running the callback would break the property the test checks. The citation meets the stated criteria, so I found no gap.
